title: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada Designated Violations Regulations
longTitle: Financial Consumer Agency of Canada Designated Violations Regulations
source: Justice Laws Website (Department of Justice Canada)

sections.heading: Definition of Act
sections.text: In these Regulations, Act means the Financial Consumer Agency of Canada Act.

sections.heading: Designation
sections.text:
The following are designated as violations that may be proceeded with under sections 20 to 31 of the Act:
    (a) the contravention of any consumer provision; and
    (b) the non-compliance with any compliance agreement entered into under an Act listed in Schedule 1 to the Act.

sections.heading: Coming into force
sections.text: These Regulations come into force on the day on which they are registered.
